record_title: Automatic boundedness for deterministic gradient-mapping accumulation
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: The result is restricted to deterministic exact full-gradient/exact-proximal Algorithm 1 with smooth f. It does not remove boundedness assumptions in the stochastic, convex nonsmooth, or accelerated regimes. The existence bound can depend on a finite pre-threshold trajectory and is not presented as a small a priori problem-data constant. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; citation-graph coverage was incomplete and future revisions of arXiv:2605.05944 could overlap.
